title: FAI Orchard Seed List
description: The hand-curated bootstrap input for the Orchard crawler. Each entry is a discovery hint — one repo the crawler should harvest in addition to whatever the GitHub Search queries return. NOT a full manifest (those live in fai-accelerator.json after normalize.js runs). Per doctrine #1 (NO HAND-MAINTAINED FRUIT LISTS), this is the ONLY manual catalog input. New entries arrive via single-line PRs. Schema is CC0-1.0.
$comment: License: CC0-1.0 (Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal — public domain dedication). SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0. Authored by FrootAI 2026-05-25 as part of Phase [A0.28] of the FAI Orchard master plan. Formalizes the input-shape contract committed in Phase [A0.7].
description: Top-level array of seed entries. Order is non-significant. The crawler dedupes against the union of discovery-queries.json results.

full_name.description: GitHub <owner>/<repo>. Case preserved exactly as it appears on GitHub. Example: Azure-Samples/azure-search-openai-demo.

variety.description: Cloud variety. Matches the variety enum in fai-accelerator.schema.json. Drives which CDN bundle the resulting fruit ships in.

stars.description: Snapshot star count at curation time. Refreshed by the crawler on every harvest run.

first_party.description: True when the repo owner is a recognized cloud-vendor org (Azure-Samples, microsoft, GoogleCloudPlatform, aws-samples, etc.). Drives the owner_type field in the resulting manifest.

reason.description: Why this is a strong seed. Encoded as a one-line technical justification (≤200 chars recommended). Used as audit context when reviewers triage seed PRs.

added_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC. When this seed was first added. Older entries may omit this field; the crawler does not depend on it.

added_by.description: Optional. GitHub username of the seed PR author OR pipeline identifier. Examples: 'github:pavle', 'fai-orchard-seed-curator/v1.0'.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes. Use for: known caveats (archived/deprecated repos), licensing flags, reviewer comments. NOT used at runtime — pure metadata.
